name: measuring FlowCell experiments comparably
from: A FlowCell specimen and test plan require measurement against other configurations or against a release gate.
to: A configuration-bound comparable measurement packet preserves calibrated raw traces, resource state, uncertainty, fixture losses, replicates, derived metrics, anomalies, and pre/post inspection.
cost: Instrument time, calibration attention, data storage, specimen/test-facility consumption.
otherwise: Architecture comparisons become confounded by different resource conditions, fixtures, calibration states, or selective best runs.
